context.en: Ashoka’s inscribed pillar at Lumbini, photographed in 2023, gives a surviving example of the Mauryan royal inscriptions and Buddhist patronage discussed here.
context.zh: 2023年拍摄的蓝毗尼阿育王铭文石柱，为条目所述孔雀王朝王室铭文与佛教供养提供了存世实例。

title.zh: 孔雀王朝：帝国与公开铭文

location.label: Pataliputra / Patna

summary.en: Chandragupta Maurya built a large state centred on Pataliputra, and his successors extended its authority across much of the subcontinent. Ashoka’s inscriptions made royal messages visible on rocks and pillars, preserving unusually direct evidence of a ruler’s ethical and political claims. His support for Buddhism connected imperial patronage with religious institutions. These texts should be read as statements of intended policy rather than proof that every subject experienced benevolent rule. Mauryan history helps compare large states whose power rested on administration, military expansion and communication across linguistically and culturally varied regions.
summary.zh: 旃陀罗笈多以华氏城为中心建立大国，后继者将权力扩展至次大陆大片地区。阿育王刻在岩石与石柱上的敕令，直接保存了君主的伦理和政治主张；其对佛教的支持，也连接皇权与宗教机构。铭文呈现的是政策宣言，不能简单等同于所有臣民的实际经历。孔雀王朝适合用于比较跨语言、跨文化帝国的战争、行政与沟通方式。

title.zh: 阿育王 · 帝国与道德治理

location.label: Pataliputra / present-day Patna

summary.en: Ashoka inherited the Mauryan state and ruled much of the Indian subcontinent. His inscriptions are unusually direct evidence for how an ancient ruler wished to address his subjects. They discuss ethical conduct, respect for living beings, public welfare, and the responsibilities of officials. After the conquest of Kalinga, an edict expressed remorse for the suffering produced by war. This public language should not be mistaken for proof that coercion disappeared from imperial government. Later Buddhist traditions also shaped his reputation. Reading inscriptions alongside those traditions helps distinguish the ruler’s own political claims, later religious memory, and the difficult question of how closely policy followed an announced ideal.
summary.zh: 阿育王继承孔雀王朝，统治印度次大陆的大部分地区。他的铭文直接展示古代统治者希望如何向臣民讲话：内容涉及道德行为、尊重生命、公共福祉和官员职责。征服羯陵伽后，一份诏令表达了对战争苦难的悔恨。这种公开语言不等于帝国治理中的强制手段从此消失。后世佛教传统也塑造了他的形象。把铭文与这些传统并读，有助于区分统治者自己的政治主张、后来的宗教记忆，以及政策是否落实理想的问题。

dateNote.en: Reign c.268–232 BCE, not lifespan. Kalinga is conventionally placed around 260 BCE; ancient chronology is approximate.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前268—232年为在位期，并非生卒年；羯陵伽战争通常置于约前260年，古代年代存在误差。

title.zh: 早期佛教 · 教导与社群

location.label: Middle Ganges region; broad context for early Buddhist history, not an identified founding spot

labelI18n.en: Middle Ganges region; broad context for early Buddhist history, not an identified founding spot
labelI18n.zh: 恒河中游地区；早期佛教的概略背景，并非特定创立地点

summary.en:
Buddhist traditions remember the Buddha as a teacher, and the museum’s account discusses karma, rebirth and nirvana as release from the cycle of earthly existence. The Metropolitan Museum’s art-historical overview places his life broadly in the fifth–fourth centuries BCE; scholars differ on more precise dates. Accounts of his life and enlightenment belong to religious traditions with their own textual histories, and cannot be treated as a single contemporaneous biography.

Monastic complexes and pilgrimage became important settings in Buddhist life. Later monuments and royal inscriptions offer different kinds of evidence: stone remains can show patronage and practice at particular places, while a ruler’s inscriptions express that ruler’s own claims. Neither establishes that every community practiced in the same way. The location is a regional reference; Buddhism continues today in many communities.
summary.zh:
佛教传统把佛陀记为一位导师；博物馆文章讨论业、轮回与涅槃，将涅槃视为从世间轮回中解脱。大都会艺术博物馆的艺术史综述将其生平宽泛地置于公元前五至前四世纪；更精确的年代仍有学术分歧。关于其生平和觉悟的叙述属于有自身文本传承的宗教传统，不能视作一份单一的同时代传记。

寺院建筑群和朝圣成为佛教生活的重要场所。后来的古迹和王室铭文属于不同类型的证据：石质遗存可显示特定地点的供养与实践，统治者铭文则表达统治者自己的主张。两者都不能证明各地社群实践完全一致。地图点只是地区参照；佛教至今仍在众多社群中延续。

dateNote.en: 500–200 BCE is a broad editorial window linking the Buddha’s debated chronology to early communities and later third-century BCE inscriptions. It is not an exact lifespan, foundation date or endpoint.
dateNote.zh: 公元前500—前200年是宽泛的编辑时段，连接佛陀有争议的年代、早期社群与后来的公元前三世纪铭文；不是精确寿命、创立日期或终点。

context.zh: 凯特·谢泼德为新西兰妇女基督教禁酒联合会撰写的1893年选举权报告封面，将投票权的取得与背后的组织运动联系起来。

title.en: New Zealand: women win the parliamentary vote
title.zh: 新西兰：女性取得国会选举投票权

location.label: Wellington; national legislation marker

summary.en: On 19 September 1893, a new Electoral Act gave women the right to vote in New Zealand parliamentary elections. The change followed years of campaigning and large petitions, including those organised by Kate Sheppard and other suffragists. It made New Zealand the first self-governing country to grant that parliamentary voting right to women. The event illustrates how organised participation can change electoral rules; it did not, by itself, complete the wider struggle for political equality.
summary.zh: 1893年9月19日，新的选举法赋予新西兰女性参加国会选举的投票权。此前，凯特·谢泼德等参政权倡导者进行了多年活动，并组织大规模请愿。新西兰由此成为首个赋予女性这一国会投票权的自治国家。这一事件展现了组织参与如何改变选举制度，但不表示更广泛的政治平等已经全部实现。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; law signed 19 September 1893. The marker indicates the legislative centre, not every place where campaigning occurred.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1893年9月19日签署法律。标记表示立法中心，并非所有运动发生地点。

title.en: Buddhist art · Stupas and images in Gandhara and Mathura
title.zh: 佛教艺术 · 犍陀罗、马图拉的佛塔与造像

location.label: Mathura; one place in the cited art history, not the extent of Buddhist communities

labelI18n.en: Mathura; one place in the cited art history, not the extent of Buddhist communities
labelI18n.zh: 马图拉；所引艺术史中的一个地点，并非佛教社群的分布范围

summary.en:
Buddhist monuments preserve evidence of patronage, worship and artistic choices. The Metropolitan Museum’s overview discusses stone railings and gateways around stupas in the first century BCE and images of the Buddha made in Gandhara and Mathura in the first century CE. These different objects invite comparison of the ways communities represented and honored their teachers and sacred places.

Dating surviving sculptures is not the same as proving when an idea or practice first appeared everywhere. Nor do shared images establish a single political authority or a uniform tradition. The marker identifies Mathura as one relevant place; the referenced works and communities were not confined to one point.
summary.zh:
佛教古迹保存着供养、礼拜与艺术选择的证据。大都会艺术博物馆的综述讨论了公元前一世纪佛塔周围的石栏与门，以及公元一世纪犍陀罗和马图拉的佛陀造像。这些不同物件可用于比较社群如何表现和尊崇导师与圣地。

为存世雕塑断代，不等于证明某种思想或实践何时在所有地方首次出现。相似图像也不能确立统一的政治权威或完全一致的传统。地图点将马图拉作为一个相关地点；所述作品与社群并不限于一个点。

dateNote.en: 100 BCE–200 CE is a broad comparison window around examples dated by the museum. It is not a universal first-image date or an end to Buddhist art.
dateNote.zh: 公元前100年至公元200年是围绕博物馆所列实例的宽泛比较时段，不是普遍的首次造像日期，也不是佛教艺术的终点。

title.zh: 佛教艺术 · 犍陀罗、马图拉的佛塔与造像

location.label: Mathura; one place in the cited art history, not the extent of Buddhist communities

labelI18n.en: Mathura; one place in the cited art history, not the extent of Buddhist communities
labelI18n.zh: 马图拉；所引艺术史中的一个地点，并非佛教社群的分布范围

summary.en:
Buddhist monuments preserve evidence of patronage, worship and artistic choices. The Metropolitan Museum’s overview discusses stone railings and gateways around stupas in the first century BCE and images of the Buddha made in Gandhara and Mathura in the first century CE. These different objects invite comparison of the ways communities represented and honored their teachers and sacred places.

Dating surviving sculptures is not the same as proving when an idea or practice first appeared everywhere. Nor do shared images establish a single political authority or a uniform tradition. The marker identifies Mathura as one relevant place; the referenced works and communities were not confined to one point.
summary.zh:
佛教古迹保存着供养、礼拜与艺术选择的证据。大都会艺术博物馆的综述讨论了公元前一世纪佛塔周围的石栏与门，以及公元一世纪犍陀罗和马图拉的佛陀造像。这些不同物件可用于比较社群如何表现和尊崇导师与圣地。

为存世雕塑断代，不等于证明某种思想或实践何时在所有地方首次出现。相似图像也不能确立统一的政治权威或完全一致的传统。地图点将马图拉作为一个相关地点；所述作品与社群并不限于一个点。

dateNote.en: 100 BCE–200 CE is a broad comparison window around examples dated by the museum. It is not a universal first-image date or an end to Buddhist art.
dateNote.zh: 公元前100年至公元200年是围绕博物馆所列实例的宽泛比较时段，不是普遍的首次造像日期，也不是佛教艺术的终点。

title.en: Nineveh: assembling and organizing written knowledge
title.zh: 尼尼微：汇集与组织书写知识

location.label: Kuyunjik, ancient Nineveh; representative tablet-collection context

summary.en: The tablets associated with Ashurbanipal’s library preserve a substantial body of seventh-century BCE scholarship at Nineveh. Their short scribal notes, called colophons, help researchers trace ownership, source texts and the movement of manuscripts. Recent study shows that the collection incorporated material from earlier generations and different places, including Assyrian as well as Babylonian sources. Medical texts reveal organized efforts to record treatments and knowledge, alongside other scholarly genres. The collection was therefore built through copying, selection and transfer rather than created entirely by one king. Surviving fragments also require careful reconstruction: a fragment count is not a count of complete ancient books.
summary.zh: 与亚述巴尼拔藏书相关的泥版，保存了尼尼微公元前7世纪的大量学术知识。称为跋记的简短书吏说明，帮助研究者追溯所有权、文本来源与抄本流动。新的研究显示，收藏吸纳了不同地点和较早世代的材料，来源既包括巴比伦，也包括亚述。医学文本显示系统记录治疗与知识的努力，并与其他学术类型并存。这一收藏通过抄写、选择和转移形成，并非一位国王独自创造。现存碎片还需谨慎拼合；碎片数量不能等同于完整古代书籍数量。

dateNote.en: 700–601 BCE represents the seventh century as an archaeological and scholarly context. It is not Ashurbanipal’s exact reign or the library’s foundation date.
dateNote.zh: 公元前700—601年表示公元前7世纪这一考古与学术背景，不是亚述巴尼拔的精确在位期或藏书机构成立日期。

en: Colophons are evidence for how tablets were identified, collected and transmitted.
Medical tablets are among the texts now being reconstructed from fragments.
zh: 跋记为泥版如何被标识、收藏和传承提供证据。
医学泥版是今日正由碎片重新整理的文本之一。

title.en: Aksum: royal conversion and Christian coinage
title.zh: 阿克苏姆：王室改宗与基督教钱币

location.label: Aksum, Ethiopia; royal-center reference point

summary.en: Christianity became associated with Aksumite kingship during the fourth century, under King Ezana. Coins provide material evidence: royal issues replaced earlier celestial symbols with the cross. Accounts of the missionary Frumentius help explain the conversion, but these written church traditions and the surviving objects are different kinds of evidence. Aksum already participated in Red Sea exchange through routes connecting its highland center with the port of Adulis. The court’s adoption of a religion therefore belonged to an interconnected African political world. Royal conversion did not mean that every subject immediately became Christian; the wider development of Christian institutions continued across later generations.
summary.zh: 四世纪埃扎纳国王统治期间，基督教开始与阿克苏姆王权结合。钱币提供了实物证据：王室铸币以十字架取代较早的天体符号。关于传教者弗鲁门提乌斯的记述有助于解释改宗，但教会文字传统与现存器物属于不同种类的证据。阿克苏姆早已通过连接高地中心和阿杜利斯港的道路参与红海交流，因此王室采纳新宗教发生在相互联系的非洲政治世界中。国王改宗并不意味着所有臣民立即成为基督徒；基督教制度的广泛发展还经历了后续许多代人。

dateNote.en: The fourth-century window represents an event whose exact year is uncertain, not a century-long conversion ceremony. Ezana’s reign is approximately dated. The pin marks Aksum, not the full kingdom.
dateNote.zh: 四世纪的时间窗口表示确切年份尚不确定，并非改宗仪式持续百年。埃扎纳的在位年代也为近似估计。点位标示阿克苏姆城，不代表整个王国。

sources.title: Foundations of Aksumite Civilization and Its Christian Legacy
sources.evidenceNote: Museum synthesis links Ezana, fourth-century Christian coin imagery and earlier Red Sea commerce; distinguishes initial elite conversion from later expansion.

sources.title: African Christianity in Ethiopia
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional interpretation compares the Frumentius church tradition with coin evidence and places conversion in the fourth century.

title.en: Timbuktu manuscripts · Law, livelihood and learning
title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿 · 法律、生计与学习

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Manuscripts preserved in libraries around Timbuktu reveal scholarship concerned with everyday obligations as well as theology. The Library of Congress exhibition describes texts on inheritance, commercial contracts, arithmetic and the social value of labour. Poems could help students remember rules; commentaries and examples allowed knowledge to be taught and debated.

The same collections also preserve the unequal institutions within which learning operated. Commercial agreements concern the trafficking of enslaved people, and an emancipation certificate records a woman being granted freedom. Ahmad Baba’s legal opinion limited permissible enslavement within Islamic law without rejecting the institution altogether. Intellectual achievement and coercive social relations therefore belong in the same history.

The selected seventeenth-to-nineteenth-century focus connects Baba’s writing to later manuscript copies, including objects catalogued as copied in 1733, 1809 and 1858. A copy date does not date the invention of its subject or every earlier version. This is a study of described surviving texts, not a new translation of their Arabic pages or a claim that legal prescriptions show how every household actually behaved.
summary.zh:
廷巴克图周边图书馆保存的手稿，显示学术既关乎神学，也关乎日常义务。美国国会图书馆展览介绍了继承、商业契约、算术及劳动社会价值的文本。诗歌可帮助学生记忆规则；注释与例题使知识能够教学和讨论。

同一批收藏也保存了学术活动所在社会的不平等制度。商业契约涉及贩运被奴役者，解放证书记载一名女性获释。艾哈迈德·巴巴的法律意见在伊斯兰法内限制可许可的奴役，却未全面否定该制度。因此，思想成就和强制性的社会关系属于同一段历史。

本条所选十七至十九世纪窗口，把巴巴著述与后来的手稿抄本相连，其中有目录注明抄于1733、1809和1858年的实物。抄写日期不是知识主题的发明年，也不是所有更早版本的年代。本条研究的是传世文本的已读解说，不是重新翻译阿拉伯语页面，也不声称法律规范证明每个家庭实际如何生活。

dateNote.en: Approximate editorial focus 1600–1858 connects seventeenth-century writing with dated later copies. It is not the beginning/end of Timbuktu scholarship. Copy years belong to particular catalogued objects, not every text discussed.
dateNote.zh: 约1600—1858年为编辑观察窗口，连接十七世纪著述与有日期的后世抄本，并非廷巴克图学术的起止年。抄写年属于特定目录实物，不适用于所有所述文本。

title.en: Mali Empire: power, exchange and historical evidence
title.zh: 马里帝国：权力、交流与历史证据

location.label: Mande heartland: a representative point, not an identified capital

summary.en: Mali grew from a kingdom in the Mande region into a state with connections across West Africa and distant trade networks. Historians reconstruct its past using oral traditions, Arabic chronicles, European accounts and archaeology. These sources answer different questions and do not always agree. Even the location and character of its capitals remain subjects of research.
summary.zh: 马里从曼德地区的王国发展为一个联系西非多地与远方贸易网络的国家。历史学家结合口述传统、阿拉伯文献、欧洲记录和考古材料重建其过去。不同来源回答的问题并不相同，也未必彼此一致；其都城的位置与性质至今仍是研究课题。

dateNote.en: Broad thirteenth-to-sixteenth-century focus follows the cited research abstract; endpoints are century bins, not exact founding and dissolution years. The marker is a regional reference, not a claimed capital.
dateNote.zh: 依据所引研究摘要，大致选取十三至十六世纪；端点是世纪分段，不是精确的建国或解体年份。标记是区域参照点，不代表已确定的首都。

title.en: Songhai: power along the Niger bend
title.zh: 桑海：尼日尔河曲的权力

location.label: Gao

summary.en: Songhai rose around the Niger River and became a major power after Mali’s influence weakened. Its rulers linked riverine agriculture and towns with wider Saharan commercial networks. Scholars, merchants and court officials participated in overlapping urban worlds, while political expansion brought diverse communities under changing authority. The Moroccan invasion of 1591 disrupted the imperial centre, though regional histories and scholarly traditions continued. Songhai should therefore be understood both as a state and as part of longer Sahelian networks. Its rise and fall help explain why the history of trade cannot be reduced to the lifespan of one empire.
summary.zh: 桑海在尼日尔河流域崛起，随马里势力减弱而成为强国。统治者把沿河农业与城市同撒哈拉商业网络连接起来，学者、商人和官员共同参与城市生活；扩张也使多样社区受其统治。1591年摩洛哥进攻破坏帝国中心，但地方历史与学术传统继续延续。桑海既是国家，也是更长期萨赫勒网络的一部分，贸易史不能等同于一个帝国的寿命。

dateNote.en: 1464–1591 follows the Met exhibition’s imperial chronology; earlier Songhai communities and later successor polities are outside this focus.
dateNote.zh: 1464—1591年采用大都会展览帝国年表，不涵盖更早桑海社区及后继政权。

summary.en: The Northern Song placed scholar-officials and civil examinations near the centre of government. Learning, political service and artistic expression became closely connected, though officials disagreed sharply about policy and their responsibilities. Court painters created images of an ordered natural world, while literati used painting and calligraphy for more personal purposes. These differences reveal competing ideas about what culture should do. Song history is therefore more than a sequence of inventions: it also offers a way to explore administration, elite recruitment and the relationship between individual expression and service to the state.
summary.zh: 北宋以士大夫和科举制度为政治核心之一，学问、仕途与艺术表达紧密联系，但官员对政策和责任也常有分歧。宫廷画家营造秩序井然的自然图景，文人则以书画表达个人志趣。不同艺术观念折射文化与国家的多种关系。宋史不仅是一串发明清单，也能帮助理解行政、精英选拔以及个人表达和公共责任之间的张力。

title.zh: 印度教 · 活态传统与社群

location.label: Cambridge, Massachusetts; location of the project documenting religious communities, not an origin site

labelI18n.en: Cambridge, Massachusetts; location of the project documenting religious communities, not an origin site
labelI18n.zh: 美国马萨诸塞州剑桥；记录宗教社群项目所在地，并非发源地

summary.en:
Hinduism is a living family of religious traditions rather than a community confined to an ancient period. Harvard’s Pluralism Project introduces Hinduism through contemporary religious life and identifies Hindu centers in the United States. This source offers one window on present communities; those centers do not define all Hindu beliefs or practices.

Related readings can compare this contemporary view with Vedic oral transmission and South Asian religious places. Such a comparison does not make Vedic traditions identical to all modern Hindu practice or assign one founder, uniform history or territorial border to Hinduism. Communities interpret and live their traditions in many contexts today.
summary.zh:
印度教是一系列延续至今的宗教传统，而不是只存在于古代的社群。哈佛大学多元宗教项目通过当代宗教生活介绍印度教，并列出美国的印度教中心。这一来源只是观察当代社群的一扇窗口，不能用这些中心概括所有印度教信仰或实践。

相关阅读可将当代视角与吠陀口传及南亚宗教地点比较。这种比较不应把吠陀传统等同于所有现代印度教实践，也不能为印度教指定单一创始人、整齐划一的历史或领土边界。如今社群在多种语境中理解并实践自己的传统。

dateNote.en: 2000–2026 is an editorial window for contemporary communities, not the origin or end of Hindu traditions. The selected project page was inspected for its contemporary scope, not a detailed historical chronology.
dateNote.zh: 2000—2026年是当代社群的编辑关注时段，不是印度教传统的起源或终点。所选项目页面只用于核查其当代范围，并非详细历史编年。

title.en: Pachacuti · Reorganizing an expanding Inca state
title.zh: 帕查库蒂 · 重组扩张中的印加国家

location.label: Cusco; representative royal and administrative center

summary.en:
Pachacuti is associated with the transformation of Cusco’s rulers into an expanding imperial power during the fifteenth century. Political narratives connect his accession with conflict against the Chancas, while the reorganization of Cusco linked rule to a capital with sacred, administrative and productive functions. Expansion drew on conquest, alliances and the incorporation of existing local authorities.

The traditions about him were written down after the Spanish conquest and do not supply an uncontested modern-style life chronology. Conventional reign dates are therefore a reference for comparison, not proof of a precise annual frontier. His significance extends beyond military victories to the organization of a diverse Andean political world. The institutions attributed to imperial rule also depended on practices developed by earlier societies. Comparing his story with regional archaeology prevents a ruler’s biography from absorbing the history of every people incorporated into Tawantinsuyu.
summary.zh:
帕查库蒂与十五世纪库斯科统治者向帝国强权的转变有关。政治叙述把他即位同对昌卡人的冲突相连，库斯科重组则把统治同具有神圣、行政及生产功能的都城联系起来。扩张依赖征服、联盟及对既有地方权威的纳入。

关于他的传统在西班牙征服后才被写下，不能提供没有争议的现代式生平年表。传统统治年代因此是比较参照，而非精确逐年边界的证明。其重要性超出战功，也涉及组织多样的安第斯政治世界。帝国制度还依赖更早社会发展的实践。把个人故事同区域考古比较，可避免统治者传记吞没被纳入塔万廷苏尤的各族历史。

dateNote.en: Working reign focus c.1438–1471 follows the British Museum; other surveys extend to c.1473. These are not birth/death dates.
dateNote.zh: 约1438—1471年的统治观察窗口采用大英博物馆；其他研究延至约1473年，并非生卒年。
